====================================================================================================
                     CobbleEffort @VERSION@: extra cosmetic forms for Cobblemon                     
====================================================================================================

CobbleEffort adds 10 collections of cosmetic forms (383 Pokemon) to Cobblemon, plus 2 new Pokemon.
Each form is a new look for an existing Cobblemon model. Every cosmetic covers whole evolutionary
lines: if one stage has it, its pre-evolutions and evolutions have it too, and the look stays
through evolution, gender, regional forms, megas and shinies (shinies get their own version).

INSTALL
-------
1. Unzip this file and put the .jar in your mods folder. It works on Fabric and NeoForge (Minecraft
   1.21.1, Cobblemon 1.7.0 or newer, built for 1.8.4).
2. Remove any older cobbleeffort-*.jar first: two copies of the same mod stop the game from
   starting.
3. It must be installed on the server too (and in single player it just works).

HOW TO GET A COSMETIC
---------------------
In survival: give a supported Pokemon the collection's item as its COSMETIC ITEM, the same way as
any Cobblemon cosmetic (hold the item, open the Pokemon's interaction menu and put it in the
cosmetic slot). Take the item back to remove the look. A Pokemon can wear one cosmetic at a time.

In creative: every collection's cosmetic items (and the Paradox mega stones) are in the CobbleEffort
tab of the creative inventory. The mega stones only show there when Mega Showdown is installed.

With commands (creative / operators): /pokegive <pokemon> <form>, for example /pokegive snorlax
christmas or /pokegive snorlax christmas shiny. The <form> word for each collection is listed below.

AT A GLANCE
-----------
  #   Collection                          Cosmetic item                                   Form word
  1   Backrooms                           Yellow Carpet                                   backrooms
  2   Thanksgiving                        Pumpkin Pie                                     thanksgiving
  3   Halloween                           Carved Pumpkin                                  halloween
  4   Christmas                           Snowball                                        christmas
  5   Easter                              Egg                                             easter
  6   Five Nights at Freddy's             Clock                                           animatronic
  7   Ice Sculptures                      Ice, Packed Ice or Blue Ice                     ice_sculpture
  8   Stone Statues                       Stone, Smooth Stone or Chiseled Stone Bricks    stone_statue
  9   Naruto / Naruto Shippuden / Boruto  Flint                                           shinobi
  10  Trans Pride                         Light Blue Banner, Pink Banner or White Banner  trans_pride

====================================================================================================
#1  BACKROOMS (STILL LIFES)  (41 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Pokemon re-imagined as Still Lifes from Kane Pixels' Backrooms: imperfect copies the Backrooms
rebuilt from memory.

Cosmetic item: Yellow Carpet
Command:       /pokegive magnemite backrooms   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * colour drained into a sallow plaster / wet-clay palette under Level 0's yellow fluorescent light
  * damp blotches, clay grain and wobbly seams; rows of the texture slipped sideways like a bad copy
  * matte painted-on eyes with a second misplaced pair just below and a smear running down
  * no glow: glowing parts are switched off
  * shiny: its own Still Life, with a faint trace of the shiny colour showing through

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Magnemite > Magneton > Magnezone
  - Omanyte > Omastar
  - Nincada > Ninjask / Shedinja
  - Torkoal
  - Anorith > Armaldo
  - Snorunt > Glalie / Froslass
  - Piplup > Prinplup > Empoleon
  - Blitzle > Zebstrika
  - Shelmet > Accelgor
  - Fletchling > Fletchinder > Talonflame
  - Swirlix > Slurpuff
  - Amaura > Aurorus
  - Xerfawn (Baby Legends) > Xerneas
  - Silicobra > Sandaconda
  - Sizzlipede > Centiskorch
  - Impidimp > Morgrem > Grimmsnarl
  - Nymble > Lokix
  - Maschiff > Mabosstiff

====================================================================================================
#2  THANKSGIVING (HARVEST)  (37 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Pokemon dressed for a Thanksgiving table.

Cosmetic item: Pumpkin Pie
Command:       /pokegive miltank thanksgiving   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * colours moved onto a harvest palette: cranberry, peach, pumpkin, maize gold, sage, chestnut,
    plum
  * greys, whites and blacks become pie-crust cream, cinnamon and dark roast
  * a golden-brown roast glaze along the edges and a few fallen maple leaves
  * eyes keep their original colours; glowing parts glow like candlelight
  * shiny: golden harvest, everything pulled toward honey-gold

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Squirtle > Wartortle > Blastoise
  - Meowth > Persian / Perrserker
  - Porygon > Porygon2 > Porygon-Z
  - Corsola > Cursola
  - Miltank
  - Kecleon
  - Bagon > Shelgon > Salamence
  - Croagunk > Toxicroak
  - Carnivine
  - Munna > Musharna
  - Tirtouga > Carracosta
  - Ferroseed > Ferrothorn
  - Mienfoo > Mienshao
  - Grubbin > Charjabug > Vikavolt
  - Bounsweet > Steenee > Tsareena
  - Pyukumuku
  - Squawkabilly
  - Wiglett > Wugtrio

====================================================================================================
#3  HALLOWEEN (NIGHTMARE)  (33 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
CONTENT WARNING: blood, gore, rotting flesh, wounds and body horror. If you don't want it, just
never use the Carved Pumpkin cosmetic.

Pokemon turned into nightmares, with animated textures (4 frames).

Cosmetic item: Carved Pumpkin
Command:       /pokegive charmander halloween   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * darkened, bruise-purple and rot-green skin with grime, lumps, torn raw patches and crude
    stitches
  * blood splatters with creeping drips
  * lots of extra, misplaced, bloodshot eyes (darting, blinking, weeping blood)
  * mouths full of jagged bloody teeth that gnash open and shut
  * shiny: a pale corpse, so the blood stands out more; glowing parts turn ghost-green

Special costumes:
  * Charmander > Charmeleon > Charizard
      Bone-Rot: skeletons with flesh rotting off the bones, an exposed rib cage, hollow eye sockets
      with a pink ember, and the tail fire burning pink
      Shiny: charred black bones

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Charmander > Charmeleon > Charizard
  - Koffing > Weezing
  - Sentret > Furret
  - Misdreavus > Mismagius
  - Absol
  - Shinx > Luxio > Luxray
  - Glameow > Purugly
  - Timburr > Gurdurr > Conkeldurr
  - Sigilyph
  - Ducklett > Swanna
  - Pancham > Pangoro
  - Comfey
  - Komala
  - Dracovish
  - Tarountula > Spidops
  - Nacli > Naclstack > Garganacl
  - Klawf
  - Veluza

#4  CHRISTMAS  (40 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Christmas costumes for four lines and a Festive look for the rest.

Cosmetic item: Snowball
Command:       /pokegive snorlax christmas   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * Festive: a Christmas palette (crimson, gold, pine, icy blue, berry), snow settled on top,
    snowflakes
  * strings of fairy lights that glow in the dark and twinkle
  * shiny: Frosted, in silver, ice and snow

Special costumes:
  * Munchlax > Snorlax
      Santa Claus: red suit with white fur trim, black belt with a gold buckle, white beard
      Shiny: an old-world Father Christmas in green
  * Turtwig > Grotle > Torterra
      Christmas tree: pine needles, baubles, gold tinsel, twinkling fairy lights and snow
      Shiny: a white flocked tree
  * Trubbish > Garbodor
      Christmas gift: candy-stripe wrapping paper, a green satin ribbon, a bow and a gift tag
      Shiny: gold foil with a red ribbon
  * Phantump > Trevenant
      Krampus: shaggy black goat fur, ram's horns, red eyes that glow in the dark, iron chains with
      gold bells
      Shiny: white fur and gold horns

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Munchlax > Snorlax
  - Turtwig > Grotle > Torterra
  - Trubbish > Garbodor
  - Phantump > Trevenant
  - Weedle > Kakuna > Beedrill
  - Mankey > Primeape > Annihilape
  - Shellder > Cloyster
  - Girafarig > Farigiraf
  - Pineco > Forretress
  - Heracross
  - Makuhita > Hariyama
  - Spiritomb
  - Skorupi > Drapion
  - Sewaddle > Swadloon > Leavanny
  - Yamask > Cofagrigus / Runerigus
  - Larvesta > Volcarona
  - Litleo > Pyroar
  - Dreepy > Drakloak > Dragapult

An Easter egg, the Easter Bunny, and a Pastel look for the rest.

Cosmetic item: Egg
Command:       /pokegive togepi easter   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * Pastel: every colour turned to its soft pastel version, a painted zigzag ribbon and little
    spring daisies
  * shiny: chocolate with rainbow candy sprinkles

Special costumes:
  * Togepi > Togetic > Togekiss
      Easter egg: a hand-painted egg with pastel bands, zigzags, polka dots and pin-stripes
      Shiny: a golden Faberge egg set with jewels
  * Buneary > Lopunny
      Easter Bunny: soft white fur, pastel-pink fluffy ears, spring daisies and a painted-egg ribbon
      Shiny: a chocolate bunny with gold-foil trim

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Togepi > Togetic > Togekiss
  - Buneary > Lopunny

#6  FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S (ANIMATRONICS)  (40 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Pokemon rebuilt as pizzeria animatronics, with eyes that glow in the dark.

Cosmetic item: Clock
Command:       /pokegive teddiursa animatronic   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * each other line wears the look of one game: Classic (FNAF 1), Withered and Toy (FNAF 2),
    Springtrap (FNAF 3), Nightmare (FNAF 4), Funtime (FNAF 5) or Scrap (FNAF 6)
  * felt, seams, rivets, grime, endoskeleton tears, wires and animatronic teeth
  * shiny: Golden animatronics

Special costumes:
  * Teddiursa > Ursaring > Ursaluna
      Classic Freddy: brown felt bear, top hat, bow tie, glowing blue eyes
      Shiny: Golden Freddy
  * Torchic > Combusken > Blaziken
      Classic Chica: yellow felt chicken with the LET'S EAT!!! bib and glowing violet eyes
      Shiny: Toy Chica
  * Sandile > Krokorok > Krookodile
      Classic Foxy: rust-red fox suit torn to the endoskeleton, eye patch, one glowing amber eye
      Shiny: Mangle (white and pink)

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Teddiursa > Ursaring > Ursaluna
  - Torchic > Combusken > Blaziken
  - Sandile > Krokorok > Krookodile
  - Seel > Dewgong
  - Horsea > Seadra > Kingdra
  - Sunkern > Sunflora
  - Murkrow > Honchkrow

  - Maractus
  - Zorua > Zoroark
  - Gothita > Gothorita > Gothitelle
  - Vanillite > Vanillish > Vanilluxe

  - Fidough > Dachsbun

====================================================================================================
#7  ICE SCULPTURES  (42 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Pokemon carved out of a block of ice.

Cosmetic item: Ice, Packed Ice or Blue Ice
Command:       /pokegive axew ice_sculpture   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * clear glacier-ice blues mapped from the Pokemon's own light and shade, so every marking is
    chiselled in
  * faceted chisel planes, refracting light streaks, hairline cracks, trapped air bubbles and a
    frosted rim
  * glints that twinkle and glow in the dark; glowing parts turn to an icy cyan glow
  * shiny: Aurora Ice, shimmering teal to violet

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Zubat > Golbat > Crobat
  - Oddish > Gloom > Vileplume / Bellossom
  - Drowzee > Hypno
  - Lickitung > Lickilicky
  - Shuckle
  - Whismur > Loudred > Exploud
  - Cranidos > Rampardos
  - Hippopotas > Hippowdon
  - Snover > Abomasnow
  - Axew > Fraxure > Haxorus
  - Skiddo > Gogoat
  - Dedenne
  - Poipole > Naganadel
  - Sobble > Drizzile > Inteleon
  - Wooloo > Dubwool
  - Sprigatito > Floragato > Meowscarada
  - Fuecoco > Crocalor > Skeledirge
  - Toedscool > Toedscruel

#8  STONE STATUES  (41 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Pokemon turned into solid, weathered stone statues.

Cosmetic item: Stone, Smooth Stone or Chiseled Stone Bricks
Command:       /pokegive aron stone_statue   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * granite-grey stone with the markings kept as carved relief
  * stone grain, speckles, chisel strokes, chipped edges, cracks and the odd patch of moss and
    lichen
  * blank carved eyes; no glow (flames become carved stone)
  * shiny: polished white marble with grey veins and gold-leaf eyes

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Pidgey > Pidgeotto > Pidgeot
  - Goldeen > Seaking
  - Tauros
  - Cyndaquil > Quilava > Typhlosion
  - Qwilfish > Overqwil

  - Rolycoly > Carkol > Coalossal
  - Stonjourner
  - Regidrago
  - Tadbulb > Bellibolt

Special costumes:
  * Vulpix > Ninetales (incl. Alolan)
      Kurama, the Nine-Tails: orange fox fur, black eye markings, red slit eyes and a flickering
      chakra glow
      Shiny: Kurama Link Mode in gold
  * Xurkitree (needs AllTheMons x Mega Showdown or Cobblemon Ultra-Beasts for its model)
      Sasuke Uchiha: spiky dark hair, glowing Sharingan, the Uchiha crest, and crackling Chidori
      lightning on both claws
      Shiny: Rinnegan purple

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Vulpix > Ninetales
  - Venonat > Venomoth
  - Onix > Steelix

====================================================================================================
#10  TRANS PRIDE  (34 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Pokemon wearing the transgender pride flag.

Cosmetic item: Light Blue Banner, Pink Banner or White Banner
Command:       /pokegive togedemaru trans_pride   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * the flag's five stripes (light blue, pink, white, pink, light blue) run across the whole body,
    head to toe, lined up across every part of the model
  * each stripe keeps the Pokemon's own shading, markings and outlines, and the eyes keep their
    colours
  * glowing parts glow in the flag's colours
  * shiny: pastel glitter, plus sparkles that twinkle and glow in the dark

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Growlithe > Arcanine
  - Chikorita > Bayleef > Meganium
  - Larvitar > Pupitar > Tyranitar
  - Zigzagoon > Linoone > Obstagoon
  - Lunatone
  - Shuppet > Banette
  - Bronzor > Bronzong
  - Azelf
  - Panpour > Simipour
  - Tympole > Palpitoad > Seismitoad
  - Emolga
  - Cobalion
  - Thundurus
  - Stufful > Bewear
  - Togedemaru
  - Dhelmise
  - Lechonk > Oinkologne
  - Charcadet > Armarouge / Ceruledge

====================================================================================================
NEW POKEMON
====================================================================================================
Pokemon Cobblemon has data for but no model, now with a model, animations and a way to get them:

#0797 CELESTEELA  (Steel / Flying, Beast Boost)
  Pale sea-green arm-rockets with white straps, cyan frills and glowing nozzle rims and tips, a
  striped sage cloak and a white segmented spire. It hovers, leans into flight, aims its arms to
  fire Flash Cannon and drops onto foes with Heavy Slam. Shiny: pearl white with rose-gold frills
  and an orange glow.
  * A roaming Ultra Beast: it can appear anywhere in the overworld at night under the open sky, very
    rarely, at level 55-60. A full moon makes it much likelier.
  * Moves, stats, typing and ability are the official Ultra Sun/Ultra Moon ones (Heavy Slam at 60).
    It flies and can't walk.
  * Commands: /pokespawn celesteela or /pokegive celesteela (add 'shiny' for the shiny).

#1022 IRON BOULDER  (Rock / Psychic, Quark Drive)
  A stone-and-steel paradox with its great blade-horns; it lowers them to charge in battle, rears up
  to cry and slashes down with Mighty Cleave. Shiny: electric-cyan accents and navy plates.
  * A roaming legendary: it can appear anywhere on the overworld surface, very rarely, at level
    70-75. Thunderstorms make it much likelier (Quark Drive / Electric Terrain).
  * Moves, stats, typing and ability are the official Scarlet/Violet ones (Mighty Cleave at level
    56).
  * Commands: /pokespawn ironboulder or /pokegive ironboulder (add 'shiny' for the shiny).

====================================================================================================
PARADOX MEGA EVOLUTIONS (needs Mega Showdown)
====================================================================================================
11 Paradox Pokemon can Mega Evolve in battle, the same way as Mega Showdown's megas: hold the mega
stone, wear a Mega Bracelet, and press Mega Evolve in battle. Every stone is crafted from a Mega
Showdown Mega Stone, a Diamond and themed items, and is in the CobbleEffort creative tab.

MEGA GREAT TUSK  (Ground / Fighting, Tough Claws)
  Stats: HP 115  Atk 171  Def 171  SpA 53  SpD 53  Spe 107  (total 670)
  Stone: Great Tuskite, crafted like this:
      [ttt]
      [sms]
      [.d.]
      t = Bone Block, s = Mud Bricks, m = Mega Stone (Mega Showdown's), d = Diamond

MEGA SCREAM TAIL  (Fairy / Psychic, Punk Rock)
  Stats: HP 115  Atk 65  Def 129  SpA 95  SpD 135  Spe 131  (total 670)
  Stone: Scream Tailite, crafted like this:
      [ttt]
      [sms]
      [.d.]
      t = Pink Wool, s = Note Block, m = Mega Stone (Mega Showdown's), d = Diamond

MEGA BRUTE BONNET  (Grass / Dark, Grassy Surge)
  Stats: HP 121  Atk 167  Def 129  SpA 79  SpD 129  Spe 45  (total 670)
  Stone: Brute Bonnetite, crafted like this:
      [ttt]
      [sms]
      [xdx]
      t = Moss Block, s = Red Mushroom Block, m = Mega Stone (Mega Showdown's), d = Diamond, x =
      Brown Mushroom

====================================================================================================
WORKS WITH
====================================================================================================
CobbleEffort is built to run alongside Mega Showdown (+ Extra Megas, Ores), Cobblemon: AllTheMons x
Mega Showdown, Cobblemon Baby Legends, Cobblemon Lost Lore, Legendary Monuments, the Fully Hisuian
Starters resource pack and the Poke Costumes data pack. None of them is required.

  * Mega Showdown megas, Gigantamax and other forms of Pokemon in a collection get their own
    cosmetic look.
  * Baby Legends' Xerfawn and Latot belong to their legendary's line (Backrooms and Easter).
  * Forms from AllTheMons x Mega Showdown, Lost Lore, Fully Hisuian Starters and Poke Costumes keep
    their own look while the cosmetic is worn (their licences don't allow recoloured copies).
